name: Zenra de Enkaigei o Saserareta Tsuma
original_name: 全裸で宴会芸をさせられた妻
source:
A talentless designer named Tanaka is the lead character of this story.
He brings his wife along to a party of a company he works with in construction and engineering, but knowing he's a man who can't turn anything work-related down, the men of that company ask that his wife become the party's entertainment. 

[from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE051707.html]DLSite English[/url]]
translation:
名叫田中的无能设计师是故事主角。他带妻子参加自己所在建筑工程公司的聚会；公司男人们知道他无法拒绝工作相关要求，于是让他的妻子充当宴会助兴节目。

[译自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE051707.html]DLSite English[/url]]
